verdicts.reason: A drops the product can entirely. The SUNSET SALE ribbon collides with the logo and headline corner, and the legal fine print sits directly under the headline, ahead of the body copy, so the reading order is wrong. The badges and CTA are jammed into a bottom cluster with the broken placeholder image overlapping SMALL BATCH, leaving no breathing room anywhere. B is essentially a uniform shrink of the original: the body copy, badges, logo and legal text are illegibly tiny at 300x250, and the placeholder still sits in the corner. Even so, B keeps the product, the hierarchy, the brand and an orderly layout, so it is the less broken of the two.
